prompt: Find the surface area of a cube with side $5$.
hint: Every face of a cube is the same square. Find the area of one face and think about how many faces there are.

hints.text: Every face of a cube is the same square. Find the area of one face and think about how many faces there are.
One face measures $5$ by $5$, so its area is $5 \times 5 = 25$. Multiply that by the $6$ faces.
$6 \times 25 = 150$, so the surface area of the cube is $150$ square units.

explanation: The surface area of a cube is $6$ times the area of one face, written $6s^2$.
With side $5$, one square face has area $5^2 = 5 \times 5 = 25$.
Multiply by the $6$ faces of the cube: $6 \times 25 = 150$.
The surface area of the cube is $150$ square units.
